title: A free freshness benchmark revalidates the pool's cited sources and reports the share of current, moved and source-dated lines and the time per question
goal: benchmarks.py run freshness (no model, no paid run) runs the lookup revalidation over the pool's answerable questions and records per provider host and over all: printed DOC lines current, moved, not found and source-dated only, wall time per question (median and p95) and requests made; the scenario's rows go to benchmarks.csv and its section to kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md, with README.md's figures where the report summarises them; --dry-run prints the sources and requests it would make.
